name: holy-clipboard
description: A desktop tray app that watches the clipboard, classifies copied passwords, tokens, and sensitive notes as confessions, logs them in a journal, assigns penance tasks, and triggers a holy-water reset when the clipboard is cleared.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run copy:renderer
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n tsc,app -c yellow,cyan "npm:watch" "wait-on dist/main/main.js && npm run copy:renderer && electron ."
